records.label: spacr.io.JoinFanOut#1
records.source: The object tables carry one row per object per field per timepoint and ``png_list`` carries one crop per the same key, so the join is one-to-one (with unmatched rows permitted by the left join) and the row count cannot grow. If it did, a join key is duplicated and every downstream measurement is multiplied.
records.context: The object tables carry one row per object per field per timepoint and ``png_list`` carries one crop per the same structured-data name, so the join is one-to-one (with unmatched rows permitted by the left join) and the row count cannot grow. If it did, a join structured-data name is duplicated and every downstream measurement is multiplied.
records.translation: Hluta töflurnar bera eina röð fyrir hlut fyrir hvert svið fyrir hvert tímabil og ``png_list`` ber eina uppskeru fyrir sama nafna á uppbyggðri gögn., svo að tengingin er einn-til-einn (með ósamræmdum röðum leyfilegum með vinstri tengingu) og fjöldi raða getur ekki vaxið. Ef hún gerir það, er nafn tengdrar uppbyggðra gagna afritað og hver niðurstreymis mæling margfaldast.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.barcode_regex#1
records.source: Barcode regexes are not filename regexes.  The sequencing pipeline requires three specifically named capture groups (``columnID``, ``grna`` and ``rowID``), so the generic filename-regex editor cannot validate this field. This module keeps the compact settings row while providing a focused dialog that compiles the expression and previews its captures against a pasted read.

records.label: spacr.io.make_validation_holdout#1
records.source: The ordinary Classify validation split used to call ``random_split`` and could put crops from one well on both sides even though grouped CV did not. This helper uses the same group-stratified partitioner as CV and selects the candidate fold closest to the requested size and class distribution.
records.context: The ordinary Classify validation split used to call ``random_split`` and could put extracted image regions from one microplate sample position on both sides even though grouped CV did not. This helper uses the same group-stratified partitioner as CV and selects the candidate fold closest to the requested size and class distribution.
records.translation: Venjulegt Classify sannprófunarskipting sem var notað kallaði á ``random_split`` og gat sett útdregna svæði mynda frá einum sýnispunktsstöðu á örtrjáblaði á báðar hliðar jafnvel þó flokkað CV gerði það ekki. Þessi hjálparforrit notar sama hópaskipta skiptingartól og CV og velur umsóknarfold nánast stærð og flokkunardreifingu sem óskað var eftir.

records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#1
records.source: The Qt layer had eleven copies of this object -- ``DbBrowserScreen._run_job``, ``PlateViewScreen._run_job``, ``ReportScreen._start_job`` and so on -- and the copies did not agree. Two of them wired ``thread.finished`` to a *closure*, which silently never retires the job (see :meth:`_retire_finished_jobs` for why), and that bug reached production twice. This module is the shape those screens converged on, written down once, so a screen that needs to stop blocking the GUI thread does not have to re-derive the rules.
records.context: The Qt layer had eleven copies of this object -- ``DbBrowserScreen._run_job``, ``PlateViewScreen._run_job``, ``ReportScreen._start_job`` and so on -- and the copies did not agree. Two of them wired ``thread.finished`` to a *closure*, which silently never retires the job (see :meth:`_retire_finished_jobs` for why), and that bug reached production twice. This module is the shape those application views converged on, written down once, so an application view that needs to stop blocking the main GUI execution path does not have to re-derive the rules.
records.translation: Qt lagið hafði ellefu eintök af þessu hlut -- ``DbBrowserScreen._run_job``, ``PlateViewScreen._run_job``, ``ReportScreen._start_job`` og svo framvegis -- og eintökin voru ekki sammála. Tvö þeirra tengdu ``thread.finished`` við *lokan*, sem hættir hljóðlaust aldrei við vinnuna (sjá :meth:`_retire_finished_jobs` fyrir ástæðu), og þessi villu komst í framleiðslu tvisvar. Þessi eining er útlit sem þessar forritsskoðanir sameinuðust um, skrifað niður einu sinni, svo forritsskoðun sem þarf að stöðva blokkun aðal GUI framkvæmdarstígsins þarf ekki að endurvinna reglurnar.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#9
records.source: The alternative considered and not taken is the Rousseeuw–Croux ``Sn`` (``1.1926 * med_i med_j |x_i - x_j|``), which is the statistically better answer: it has a 50% breakdown point, needs no symmetry assumption, and does not collapse on tied data. It is not used because the naive form is O(n^2) — unusable on the 10^5–10^6 object rows spaCR routinely produces — and the O(n log n) algorithm is a page of intricate code to maintain for a path that is only ever reached when the MAD has *already* collapsed. The mean absolute deviation has a 0% breakdown point and that is stated plainly rather than glossed: it is a stopgap that keeps a degenerate column from flagging its whole tail, not a robust estimator. If the fallback fires, the honest reading is that the column is not continuous enough for this test.

It is not used because the naive form is O(n^2) — unusable on the 10^5–10^6 object rows spaCR routinely produces — and the O(n log n) algorithm is a page of intricate code to maintain for a path that is only ever reached when the MAD has *already* collapsed. The mean absolute deviation has a 0% breakdown point and that is stated plainly rather than glossed: it is a stopgap that keeps a degenerate column from flagging its whole tail, not a robust estimator. If the fallback fires, the honest reading is that the column is not continuous enough for this test.
records.translation: Hin valkosturinn sem var íhugaður en ekki tekinn er Rousseeuw–Croux ``Sn`` (``1.1926 * med_i med_j |x_i - x_j|``), sem er tölfræðilega betri lausn: hann hefur 50% brotpunkt, þarf enga jöfnunarforsendur, og hrakar ekki við jöfnuð gögn. Hann er ekki notaður því óreyndi formið er O(n^2) — ekki nothæft á 10^5–10^6 raðir af hlutum spaCR sem venjulega eru framleiddar — og O(n log n) reiknirit er blað af flóknum kóða til að viðhalda fyrir leið sem aðeins er alltaf náð þegar MAD hefur *áður* hrakað. Meðal algjör frávik hefur 0% brotpunkt og það er sagt skýrt frekar en að fegra: það er neyðarúrræði sem kemur í veg fyrir að þroskuð dálkur vekji viðvörun fyrir alla hala sinn, ekki traust matstæki. Ef bakfallið virkjar, er heiðarleg túlkun sú að dálkurinn sé ekki nógu samfellt fyrir þennan próf.

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.get_ambient_enabled#2
records.source: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". The three install sites all read this function before they build anything, so answering ``False`` for None here is what makes the guarantee true everywhere at once, without a second condition in three other modules that could drift apart.
records.context: **Two keys answer this one question, and both are honoured.** The Animation preference gained a ``None`` entry (see :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), and "no animation" has to mean *nothing is constructed* rather than "an engine that paints an empty frame sixty times a second". The three install sites all read this function before they build anything, so answering ``False`` for None here is what makes the guarantee true everywhere at once, without a second condition in three other modules that could drift apart.
records.translation: **Tveir lyklar svara þessari einni spurningu, og báðir eru virðir.** Kvikmyndavalsforritið fékk ``None`` færslu (sjá :data:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.NO_ANIMATION`), og "no animation" verður að þýða *ekkert er byggt* frekar en „vélar sem málar tóman ramma sextíu sinnum á sekúndu“. Öll þrjú uppsetningarstaðsetningin lesa þessa aðgerð áður en þeir byggja neitt, svo að svara ``False`` fyrir None hér er það sem gerir tryggingana sanna alls staðar í einu, án annars skilyrðis í þremur öðrum einingum sem gætu dreifst í sundur.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#5
records.source: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``bokeh`` Out-of-focus points of light, the way a fluorescence field looks off the focal plane: an aperture image is a *disc with a bright rim*, not a Gaussian smudge, and the ones further out of focus are larger and flatter. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre.
records.context: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``bokeh`` Out-of-focus points of light, the way a fluorescence field looks off the focal image layer: an aperture image is a *disc with a bright rim*, not a Gaussian smudge, and the ones further out of focus are larger and flatter. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre.
records.translation: ``aurora`` Þrjár samliggjandi gardínur af lóðréttum geislum, fellingar í lengd sinni. Fellingarnar eru ferðabylgjur — nokkrar lagðar tíðnir sem fara eftir lengd bogans — með birtuskotum á sérstöku tímaáætlun, skörp lágbrún, mjúk efri brún, og lóðrétta litarröð raunveruleikans: grænn um líkamann, rauður ofar, fjólublár skeljarbrún neðan við. ``ripple`` Samhverfur hringir sem víðast út frá þremur föstum uppsprettum og dofna þegar þeir stækka, eins og rigning á vatni. Mjúkar brúnir, svo það lesst aldrei sem línuteikning. ``drift`` Hæg stjörnuhiminn í þremur parallax lögum: litlar, dimmar, hægar aftast; stærri, bjartari, hraðari fremst. Þemað eitt skýrt. Það ferðast upp, niður, eða í allar áttir — sjá :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``bokeh`` Óskýr ljósapunktar, eins og flúorskortssvið lítur út fyrir utan fókuslag myndarinnar: myndgat er *diskur með björtum jaðri*, ekki Gauss-myrkri, og þeir sem eru utar í ófókusi eru stærri og flatari. ``cells`` Frumur fljóta í gegnum sviðið, snúast á leiðinni — mjúkur bolur, aðeins bjartari himna þar sem brúnin sést næstum í brún, og greinilega bjartari kjarni staðsettur miðjulaust.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_controls#47
records.source: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same plate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).
records.context: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same laboratory microplate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).
records.translation: Sýnið er **handahóf en endurtekjanlegt**: fræið er stöðugt útdráttur af ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), þannig að sama rannsóknarstofa örbretti við sama lok gefur sömu sett í þessari lotu, næstu lotu og á öðru tæki eða festingarstað — forskoðun má lýsa og skila aftur. Það er viljandi *ekki* sett upp af klukkunni eða frá ``hash()``, sem er saltað fyrir hvert ferli. Endurrennslun teiknar aldrei aftur; aðeins skýr aðgerð gerir það — að breyta lokinu (sem er í fræinu) eða kalla á :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (sem hækka nonce).

records.label: spacr.plot.proportion_test_by_unit#1
records.source: The object-level chi-squared asks whether 20,000 objects came from one distribution. Objects in a well share a treatment, a transfection, an imaging session and a monolayer, so that is not the question anyone asked, and its p-value is smaller than the experiment supports by orders of magnitude. This asks the question the design supports: do the WELLS differ, with n = the number of wells.
records.context: The object-level chi-squared asks whether 20,000 objects came from one distribution. Objects in a microplate sample position share a treatment, a transfection, an imaging session and a monolayer, so that is not the question anyone asked, and its p-value is smaller than the experiment supports by orders of magnitude. This asks the question the design supports: do the Microplate sample positions differ, with n = the number of microplate sample positions.
records.translation: Chi-ferning á hlutastigi spyr hvort 20.000 hlutir komu úr einni dreifingu. Hlutir í sýnatökustöðu á örplötu deila meðferð, umritun, myndatöku og einlaga, svo það er ekki sú spurning sem einhver spurði, og p-gildið hennar er minna en tilrauninn styður um margföldun. Þetta spyr þá spurningu sem hönnunin styður: eru sýnatökustöður á örplötu mismunandi, með n = fjöldi sýnatökustaða á örplötu.

records.label: spacr.crop_source#2
records.source: ``pre_generated`` Crops already written to disk by the measure step. Selected by ``path_string`` (a substring the path must contain) and ``file_type`` (the image extension). Nothing is cut here; the images exist. ``on_demand`` Crops cut from ``merged/*.npy`` as training runs. A merged array holds both intensity planes and mask planes, so this needs to be told which are which: ``extract_channels`` names the intensity planes and ``object_array`` names the object whose mask defines each crop's extent. Optionally the objects come from a DATABASE instead, via ``coordinate_columns``. ``generate`` Cut a full crop set to disk first, then train on it as ``pre_generated`` would.
records.context: ``pre_generated`` Extracted image regions already written to disk by the measure step. Selected by ``path_string`` (a substring the path must contain) and ``file_type`` (the image extension). Nothing is cut here; the images exist. ``on_demand`` Extracted image regions cut from ``merged/*.npy`` as training processing sessions. A merged array holds both intensity image layers and mask image layers, so this needs to be told which are which: ``extract_channels`` names the intensity image layers and ``object_array`` names the object whose mask defines each extracted image region's extent. Optionally the objects come from a DATABASE instead, via ``coordinate_columns``. ``generate`` Cut a full extracted image region set to disk first, then train on it as ``pre_generated`` would.
records.translation: ``pre_generated`` Útdregnar myndasvæðismyndir þegar skrifaðar á disk af mæliþættinum. Valdar af ``path_string`` (undastrengi sem slóðin verður að innihalda) og ``file_type`` (myndaendingu). Hér er ekkert skorið; myndirnar eru til. ``on_demand`` Útdregin myndasvæðismyndir skorin úr ``merged/*.npy`` sem þjálfunarferli. Sameinaður fylki heldur bæði styrkleikahlutum myndlagasafns og maskalagum, svo þetta þarf að segja hvað er hvað: ``extract_channels`` gefur heiti styrkleikahluta myndlagsins og ``object_array`` nafngift viðfangsefnis sem maski þess skilgreinir umfang hvers útdregins myndasvæðis. Að vali koma viðfang sem koma frá GAGNASAFNI í staðinn, í gegnum ``coordinate_columns``. ``generate`` Skerðu fulla útdragna myndasvæðasetti á disk fyrst, og þjálfaðu svo á því eins og ``pre_generated`` myndi.

records.label: spacr.qt.imagery.render#3
records.source: The dim solve runs here as well as in :func:`build_master`, and it is deliberately not redundant: on the shipped masters it resolves to a no-op because they are already at the limit, but a user who drops their own photograph into ``~/.spacr/themes`` gets the same guarantee without having to know it exists. Solving costs one pass over a 480 px thumbnail plus one 256-entry lookup table.

records.translation: Dökku leysa keyrir hér sem og í :func:`build_master`, og það er viljandi ekki óþarft: á þeim sendu meistarum leysist það sem engin aðgerð vegna þess að þeir eru þegar komnir að takmörkun, en notandi sem stingur eigin ljósmynd í ``~/.spacr/themes`` fær sama ábyrgðina án þess að þurfa að vita að hún sé til. records.label: spacr.train_compare#7
records.source: The settings that produced a run are *not* in the run folder: ``save_settings`` writes them to ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` as a ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` walks up from the run folder to find it — but only as far as the run's own project root, which the layout above makes identifiable: ``<src>`` is the folder the ``model/`` tree hangs off. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this run's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. See :func:`_owns_this_run`.
records.context: The settings that produced a processing session are *not* in the processing-session folder: ``save_settings`` writes them to ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` as a ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` walks up from the processing-session folder to find it — but only as far as the processing session's own project root, which the layout above makes identifiable: ``<src>`` is the folder the ``model/`` tree hangs off. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this processing session's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. See :func:`_owns_this_run`.
records.translation: Stillingarnar sem framleiddu vinnslufund eru *ekki* í vinnslufundar-möppunni: ``save_settings`` skrifar þær í ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` sem ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` gengur upp frá vinnslufundar-möppunni til að finna það — en aðeins eins langt og verkefnarót vinnslufundarins sjálfs, sem uppsetningin hér að ofan gerir auðþekkjanlega: ``<src>`` er mappan sem ``model/`` tré hangir af. Forfaðir ofan þess tilheyrir öðru verkefni, og lesning þess myndi skrástillingarnar annarra sem uppruna þessa vinnslufundar, svo stillingarmunurinn myndi sýna mun sem enginn stillti og svarið myndi ráðast af því hvar í skráarkerfinu verkefnið sat. Sjá :func:`_owns_this_run`.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.install_api_tooltips#2
records.source: draw the teal link dots. Hover help is installed either way -- this only controls the visible dot. Forms with a setting on nearly every row read as a column of dots rather than a column of settings, which is why the Mask live preview turns them off: 68 of them on one dialog. The Annotate settings dialog turns them off for the same reason -- twenty-six settings, so twenty-six dots -- and because the API link is in the hover tooltip either way, which is where users were reading it from. Anywhere the settings are sparse enough for a dot to look like an affordance rather than texture, leave it on.

records.translation: teiknaðu tealu tengidöðlurnar. Aðstoðarvafningur er samt sem áður uppsettur -- Þetta stjórnar aðeins sýnilega punktinum. Form með stillingu á næstum hverri röð eru lesin sem dálkur af punktum frekar en dálkur af stillingum., þess vegna slökkva forsýningarnar í Mask á þeim: 68 þeirra í einum samræðu. Hvar sem stillingarnar eru nógu þunnar til að punktur líti út eins og möguleiki fremur en áferð, skaltu láta hann vera.

records.label: spacr.qt.preview_registry#1
records.source: Four modules have a preview — Mask, Measure, Timelapse, Motility — and each one costs a thirteen-line arm in ``AppScreen._build_runtime_panel``, two attribute names in a null-out block, and a row in a toggle table two hundred lines further down. The fifth would cost the same, which is why there has never been a fifth: the modules that would most obviously benefit from one are the two whose entire job is "did the mask come out right" — Cellpose Masks and Plaque Assay — and neither was worth touching the shared screen for.

records.translation: Fjórir einingar hafa forskoðun — Gríma, Mæla, Tímalögn, Hreyfanleiki — og hver kostar þrettán línu arm í ``AppScreen._build_runtime_panel``, tvö eignanafn í núll-stilla blokk, og röð í skiptingartöflu tvöhundruð línur lengra niður. Sú fimmta myndi kosta það sama, þess vegna hefur aldrei verið fimmti: módelin sem myndu augljóslega hafa mest gagn af einu eru þau tvö sem hela starf þeirra er „kom maskinn rétt út“ — Cellpose Grímur og plökupróf — og hvorugt var þess virði að snerta sameiginlega skjáinn fyrir.
